correctionReason: The earlier production-live evidence inferred successful V2.2 commercial migrations from a combined Railway preDeployCommand string. Subsequent production preflight proved migrations 007-011 were still pending because Railway executed only the first command segment.

resolution.wrapperCommand: npm run preflight:v22-production && npm run migrate:runtime

conclusion: The earlier V2.2 Runtime deployment was live, but the commercial database migration state was not complete. The corrected deployment above is the first fully verified V2.2 commercial production baseline.
